<span class="hl-kw">&lt;?php</span>

    <span class="hl-kw">public</span> <span class="hl-kw">static</span> <span class="hl-kw">function</span> fromArray(<span class="hl-kw">array</span> <span class="hl-var">$data</span>): <span class="hl-kw">self</span>
    {
        <span class="hl-kw">return</span> <span class="hl-kw">new</span> <span class="hl-kw">self</span>(
            propsAsArray: <span class="hl-var">$data</span>[<span class="hl-str">'propsAsArray'</span>],
            propsAsTrue: <span class="hl-var">$data</span>[<span class="hl-str">'propsAsTrue'</span>],
            propsAsZero: <span class="hl-var">$data</span>[<span class="hl-str">'propsAsZero'</span>],
            itemsFalse: <span class="hl-var">$data</span>[<span class="hl-str">'itemsFalse'</span>],
            addlArray: <span class="hl-var">$data</span>[<span class="hl-str">'addlArray'</span>],
            addlNull: <span class="hl-var">$data</span>[<span class="hl-str">'addlNull'</span>],

            patternFalsy: <span class="hl-var">$data</span>[<span class="hl-str">'patternFalsy'</span>],
            typeNumber: <span class="hl-var">$data</span>[<span class="hl-str">'typeNumber'</span>],
            typeMixedArray: <span class="hl-var">$data</span>[<span class="hl-str">'typeMixedArray'</span>],
            requiredBad: <span class="hl-var">$data</span>[<span class="hl-str">'requiredBad'</span>],
        );
    }

    <span class="hl-comment">/** @return array&lt;string, mixed&gt; */</span>
    <span class="hl-kw">public</span> <span class="hl-kw">function</span> toArray(): <span class="hl-kw">array</span>
    {
        <span class="hl-kw">return</span> [
            <span class="hl-str">'propsAsArray'</span> =&gt; <span class="hl-var">$this</span>-&gt;propsAsArray,
